label: Run $ZED_CUSTOM_java_class_name
command: $cls = "$ZED_CUSTOM_java_class_name"; $pkg = "$ZED_CUSTOM_java_package_name"; if ($pkg) { $main = "$pkg.$cls" } else { $main = $cls }; if (Test-Path .\gradlew.bat) { .\gradlew.bat run --args="-PmainClass=$main" } elseif (Test-Path ./gradlew) { ./gradlew run --args="-PmainClass=$main" } elseif (Test-Path pom.xml) { mvn compile exec:java -Dexec.mainClass="$main" } else { Write-Error 'No build system found' }

label: Test $ZED_CUSTOM_java_class_name.$ZED_CUSTOM_java_method_name
command: $cls = "$ZED_CUSTOM_java_class_name"; $pkg = "$ZED_CUSTOM_java_package_name"; $outer = "$ZED_CUSTOM_java_outer_class_name"; if ($outer) { $inner = "$outer`$$cls" } else { $inner = $cls }; if ($pkg) { $fq = "$pkg.$inner" } else { $fq = $inner }; if (Test-Path .\gradlew.bat) { .\gradlew.bat test --tests "$fq" } elseif (Test-Path ./gradlew) { ./gradlew test --tests "$fq" } elseif (Test-Path pom.xml) { mvn test -Dtest="$fq#$ZED_CUSTOM_java_method_name" } else { Write-Error 'No build system found' }

label: Test class $ZED_CUSTOM_java_class_name
command: $cls = "$ZED_CUSTOM_java_class_name"; $pkg = "$ZED_CUSTOM_java_package_name"; $outer = "$ZED_CUSTOM_java_outer_class_name"; if ($outer) { $inner = "$outer`$$cls" } else { $inner = $cls }; if ($pkg) { $fq = "$pkg.$inner" } else { $fq = $inner }; if (Test-Path .\gradlew.bat) { .\gradlew.bat test --tests "$fq" } elseif (Test-Path ./gradlew) { ./gradlew test --tests "$fq" } elseif (Test-Path pom.xml) { mvn test -Dtest="$fq" } else { Write-Error 'No build system found' }

label: Run all tests
command: if (Test-Path .\gradlew.bat) { .\gradlew.bat test } elseif (Test-Path ./gradlew) { ./gradlew test } elseif (Test-Path pom.xml) { mvn test } else { Write-Error 'No build system found' }
